problem:
The quadratic Taylor approximation of the function $f(x)$ about $x=a\in {R}^{3}$ is given by

$$
f(x)≈16+\frac{1}{2}(x-a)^{T}A(x-a),
$$

where 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 & -4 \\ 1 & 2 & -1 \\ -4 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

 

Which of the following statements are true?

- ${a}_{11}=3$ and $det(A)>0$
- $A$ is neither positive-definite nor negative-definite
- $a$ is a saddle point of $f$

choices.value: None of the statements are true
